title: Beyond-Light Cross-Source Experiments
content: One independent cross-source predictive screen. The stored result says no pattern outperformed the baseline and the second-source result was not replicated.

source.extraction_method: verbatim source-file import; record index generated without altering source records

knowledge.hypothesis: A fitted pattern can predict RL10 specific impulse across the two imported source datasets better than a constant baseline.
knowledge.method: Cross-source predictive screen using two distinct NASA RL10 report datasets; not a matched-condition physical replication.
results: No candidate pattern outperformed the constant baseline on the internal cross-validation screen.
The cross-source screen was not replicated on the second source dataset.
limitations: The record reports that no pattern outperformed the baseline.
The source datasets use different engine variants and test conditions; this is not strict replication or a universal RL10 law.
